title: The Northern Lights Over a Quiet Road
short_teaser: Auroras occur when charged particles from the Sun interact with Earth’s magnetic field and atmosphere.
story: Auroras occur when charged particles from the Sun interact with Earth’s magnetic field and atmosphere. The result can turn a dark sky into moving curtains of color. Wonder can arrive when invisible forces become briefly visible. Wonder interrupts routine and restores perspective. It reminds us that the world still contains more than we have noticed. The lasting value is not merely knowing the fact. It is seeing the pattern beneath it and considering where that same pattern may already be present in ordinary life, creative work, or business.
impact: Wonder can arrive when invisible forces become briefly visible. Wonder interrupts routine and restores perspective. It reminds us that the world still contains more than we have noticed.
